# Peter Chng

> > Personal technical blog exploring machine learning systems, GPU computing, and performance optimization with deep dives into FlashAttention, Transformers, and CUDA programming.

Peter Chng's website features technical writing on ML infrastructure, neural network optimization, and low-level systems programming. The content focuses on practical implementations and performance analysis of modern deep learning techniques.

## Key Topics

- FlashAttention
- Ring Attention
- Transformer KV Cache
- CUDA programming
- GPU computing
- Machine learning systems
- Performance optimization
- Neural networks
- Roofline Model
- LLM infrastructure
- x86-64 architecture
- BatchNorm
- Technical deep dives
